bots.builtin.intro: Built-in bots run inside LobbyForge. They post as bots — with the BOT badge — and only with the permissions they need.
bots.builtin.title: Built-in bots
bots.cannotMutate: Sign in as the owner to change bots.
bots.confirm.deleteBody: {name} will be removed. Messages it already posted stay in their channels, still marked as a bot's. Its token stops working.
bots.confirm.revokeBody: {name} can no longer call the Bot API until you give it a new token. The bot itself stays.
bots.confirm.rotateBody: The current token of {name} stops working immediately. Update your bot with the new one.
bots.custom.intro: Connect your own program through the Bot API. Each bot gets a token, shown once, and can only do what you allow here.
bots.custom.nameHint: Shown next to the BOT badge on everything the bot posts.
bots.custom.title: Custom bots
bots.error.builtinFixed: A built-in bot always has the same permissions.
bots.error.forbidden: You need the Manage Community permission to change bots.
bots.error.invalid: Some of these values are not valid. Check the fields and try again.
bots.error.invalidChannel: Pick a text channel that every member can see.
bots.error.limit: A server can have at most {count, plural, one {# custom bot} other {# custom bots}}.
bots.error.massMention: Bot messages can't mention @everyone or @here. Remove it and save again.
bots.error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
bots.error.notFound: This bot no longer exists. Reload the page.
bots.error.rateLimited: Too many changes at once. Wait a moment and try again.
bots.error.signIn: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
bots.error.ungrantable: You cannot give a bot permissions you do not have yourself: {permissions}.
bots.field.name: Name
bots.moderation.allowedDomainsHint: One per line, like example.com. Its subdomains are allowed too.
bots.moderation.auditNote: Every blocked message is written to the audit log: the rule, a short excerpt and the member.
bots.moderation.blocked.blocked_word: Your message was not sent: it contains a word this community does not allow.
bots.moderation.blocked.flood: Your message was not sent: you are sending messages too quickly. Wait a moment.
bots.moderation.blocked.generic: Your message was blocked by the moderation bot.
bots.moderation.blocked.link: Your message was not sent: links like this are not allowed here.
bots.moderation.blocked.mentions: Your message was not sent: it mentions too many people at once.
bots.moderation.blocked.repeat: Your message was not sent: you have already sent that several times.
bots.moderation.blockedWordsHint: One word or phrase per line. Capital letters, and Turkish İ and ı, do not matter. End a word with * to also catch longer forms: "spam*" also blocks "spammer".
bots.moderation.defaultNotice: A message from {user} was blocked by the moderation filter.
bots.moderation.description: Checks every new or edited message before it is posted: blocked words, links, mass mentions, repeats and flooding.
bots.moderation.exemptStaffHint: Members who can manage messages or the server are never filtered.
bots.moderation.floodHint: Block a member who sends more messages than this in the time window.
bots.moderation.maxMentionsHint: 0 means no limit. @everyone and @here count too.
bots.moderation.noticeTemplateHint: {user} is replaced with the member's name.
bots.moderation.postNotice: Post a notice in the channel
bots.moderation.postNoticeHint: A short, neutral line when a message is blocked — at most one per member per minute.
bots.moderation.repeatHint: Block the same message sent more times than this in the time window.
bots.moderation.tooManyDomains: Too many sites: the limit is {count}.
bots.moderation.tooManyWords: Too many blocked words: the limit is {count}.
bots.permissionHint.read_members: Learn when members join or leave, and look up a member's name and roles.
bots.permissionHint.receive_events: Get events live, over the gateway or at its own HTTPS address, instead of polling.
bots.permissionHint.slash_commands: Register slash commands and answer the members who run them.
bots.subtitle: Bots that greet newcomers, keep chat clean or connect your own programs. A bot is always marked with a BOT badge.
bots.title: Bots
bots.token.body: Copy this token into your bot now. This is the only time it is shown — LobbyForge keeps only a fingerprint of it.
bots.token.label: Bot token
bots.token.title: Token for {name}
bots.token.warning: Anyone with this token can post as the bot. Keep it secret; if it leaks, create a new one.
bots.welcome.channelHint: Only text channels every member can see are listed.
bots.welcome.defaultTemplate: Welcome to {server}, {user}! Glad you are here.
bots.welcome.description: Greets every new member in a channel you choose.
bots.welcome.templateHint: {user} is replaced with the new member's name, {server} with the server's name.
